openLink.notAddress: This is not a web address Gostman can open.
openLink.credentials: Addresses that contain a user name or password are not allowed.
openLink.noHost: The address has no host name.
openLink.reachFailure: Gostman could not reach the server that sends this file. Check your connection and try again.
openLink.title: Open from a link
openLink.intro: A link asked Gostman to download a collection or a spec. Nothing is downloaded or added until you choose Download, and nothing is imported until you choose Import.
openLink.trustNote: Only continue if you trust the person who sent you this link.
openLink.activeNote: Scripts, OAuth 2.0 settings, local MCP commands or file reads in {{items}}. You are asked before those are imported, and imported folders stay restricted until you trust them.
openLink.builderHint: Paste the address of a collection or spec published online (a Postman collection, OpenAPI file, Insomnia, HAR or Gostman export). The links below let readers of your README open it in Gostman after a confirmation.
